verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shortcut connecting to external agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI through its MCP server. It also says the product tracks work from 'people and agents'. Neither shows a built-in AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to; external-agent integrations are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
